title: Full-Platform Content Marketing Firm Mobei Media Raises ¥25M Series A
summary: Full-social content-marketing leader Mobei Media (墨北传媒) / Suzhou Wenshi (founded 2017; HQ Suzhou; subs in Guangzhou, Chengdu, Qingdao; >12k m²) closed a ¥25M Series A led by Jingtou Zhichuang with other LPs — for seven national ops centers, market expansion, digital management,
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 21, 2022

Full-social content-marketing leader Mobei Media (墨北传媒) / Suzhou Wenshi (founded 2017; HQ Suzhou; subs in Guangzhou, Chengdu, Qingdao; >12k m²) closed a ¥25M Series A led by Jingtou Zhichuang with other LPs — for seven national ops centers, market expansion, digital management, and creator incubation. Businesses: brand marketing (e.g. Hongxing Erke VI), film/TV promo (e.g. The Battle at Lake Changjin II), content commerce (Bai Xiang), creator training. 40+ Tier-1 brands, 100+ film/TV projects, 30+ KOLs. Controller Zhao Liuwei 100%.

— END —
